name: On Browser Home Page
description: Start from a fresh browser tab and open Hulu's auth flow.
triggers: If the browser is on a new tab or blank page
actions: Navigate directly to https://auth.hulu.com/web/login and wait for Hulu to load.

name: Hulu Email Login
description: Hulu is asking for the account email before playback.
triggers: If the page has a Hulu email input field
actions: Use the type_env action with env_var HULU_EMAIL to type the email into the email field. Never type or save the raw email in generated JSON.

name: Hulu Password Login
description: Hulu is asking for the account password before playback.
triggers: If the page has a Hulu password input field
actions: Use the type_env action with env_var HULU_PASSWORD to type the password into the password field. Never type or save the raw password in generated JSON.
Submit the login form and wait for the account page or watch page to load.
Navigate directly to https://www.hulu.com/watch/60da223c-d2a0-411a-95c9-665a839371f9 and wait for the player to load.

name: Hulu Verification Required
description: Hulu is asking for an email passcode or additional verification.
triggers: If the page says Check your email inbox
actions: Terminate the workflow because manual verification is required.

name: Hulu Profile Selection
description: Hulu is asking which profile is watching.
triggers: If the page says Who's watching?
actions: Use the env-backed text click action to select the Hulu profile named by HULU_PROFILE_NAME.
Navigate directly to https://www.hulu.com/watch/60da223c-d2a0-411a-95c9-665a839371f9 and wait for the player to load.

name: Watching Hulu Video
description: On the Hulu watch page with a video player available.
triggers: If the current page has an HTML video player element
actions: Click the video player once to start or focus playback if necessary.
Start video stats logging to /out/hulu_watch_stats.jsonl every 2 seconds.
